Company: Tomtom
Title: Platform Engineering Internship - Observability
Location: Amsterdam, The Netherlands
Visa: 
The Observability Platform team is responsible for managing the capabilities that help identifying the issues within TomTom’s online products and ensure they are timely fixed to enable best customer experience. We drive improving the operational quality and effectiveness of the service and aim to enable self-service for our users by system engineering and software development. The position is targeted towards last-year students with a potential to become a full-time employee over the course of 6-12 months. What you’ll do: As a Platform Engineer you will work on addressing reliability, availability, scalability, efficiency for your team’s components and help the rest of the company benefit from them. You will manage existing Observability tools and help internal customers master them. You will learn by example about the architecture, design, standards, and implementation of new and existing systems to enhance their functionality, reliability, efficiency and scalability with a moderate level of autonomy.
